label: Derivative
usage: Contract deriving value from an asset

label: Option
usage: Right to buy or sell at a strike

label: Futures
usage: Agreement to trade at a future date

label: Collateral
usage: Asset pledged to secure a loan

label: Escrow
usage: Funds held by a neutral third party

label: Operational Risk
usage: Risk from process or system failure

label: Onboarding
usage: Bringing a new client into service

label: Monetary Policy
usage: Central bank rate and supply control

label: Fiduciary Duty
usage: Obligation to act in client interest

label: Syndicated Loan
usage: Loan from a group of lenders

label: Expense Ratio
usage: Fund operating cost as a percentage

label: Net Interest Margin
usage: Spread between lending and deposit rates

label: Safe Deposit Box
usage: Rented secure storage in a branch

label: Letter of Credit
usage: Bank guarantee of payment in trade
